description: This Java class 'PermissionRecorder' provides services for managing and recording permissions related to content entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting permission parameters, recording permission checks, and generating HTML reports of permission checks.

classes.name: PermissionRecorder
classes.description: Main class providing permission recording and reporting functionalities.

methods.name: PermissionRecorder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the permission recorder based on configuration property.

methods.name: getCheckMode
methods.description: Returns the current permission check mode.

methods.name: setCheckMode
methods.description: Sets the permission check mode.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Checks if the permission recorder is enabled.

methods.name: setOn
methods.description: Enables or disables the permission recorder.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the current user login information.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Sets the user login information.

methods.name: getEntityPermCheckResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the entity permission check.

methods.name: setEntityPermCheckResult
methods.description: Sets the result of the entity permission check.

methods.name: getContentPurposeOperations
methods.description: Returns a clone of the content purpose operations array.

methods.name: setContentPurposeOperations
methods.description: Sets the content purpose operations from a list.

methods.name: getPrivilegeEnumId
methods.description: Returns the privilege enumeration ID.

methods.name: setPrivilegeEnumId
methods.description: Sets the privilege enumeration ID.

methods.name: getStatusTargets
methods.description: Returns a clone of the status targets array.

methods.name: setStatusTargets
methods.description: Sets the status targets from a list.

methods.name: getTargetOperations
methods.description: Returns a clone of the target operations array.

methods.name: setTargetOperations
methods.description: Sets the target operations from a list.

methods.name: setCurrentContentId
methods.description: Sets the current content ID and initializes related data structures.

methods.name: getCurrentContentId
methods.description: Returns the current content ID.

methods.name: setRoles
methods.description: Sets roles associated with the current content.

methods.name: setPurposes
methods.description: Sets purposes associated with the current content.

methods.name: startMatchGroup
methods.description: Begins a new permission match group with specified parameters.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a permission check result with specified conditions.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML report of the permission check results.

methods.name: renderCurrentContentMapHtml
methods.description: Renders HTML for a given content map.

methods.name: renderResultRowHtml
methods.description: Renders HTML for a permission check result row.
